close_reason: opinion: early return in axum handlers is idiomatic
description: jmap_api_handler has 'return (...).into_response()' in the None arm of the jmap match. This is idiomatic in axum handlers because early return from an impl IntoResponse fn is the standard pattern — not a Rust idiom violation. No change needed. Marking as reviewed/opinion.
title: return used as last expression in early-return arms of jmap_api_handler
